newsitem.title: USA: Westinghouse to redeem Class C preferred.
newsitem.headline: Westinghouse to redeem Class C preferred.

text.p: Westinghouse Electric Corp said it plans to redeem all outstanding shares of Series C Conversion Preferred Stock on May 30.
Westinghouse has about 3,599,890 Series C shares outstanding. The Series C shares were issued in March 1994.

In accordance with terms of the offering, all shares of the Series C stock will convert into Westinghouse common stock at an exchange rate of 8.85 shares of common stock for each share of Series C, equivalent to .885 of a share of Westinghouse common stock for each $1.30 depositary share.
Each depositary share represents one-tenth of a share of Series C. All accrued and unpaid dividends on the redeemed shares of Series C stock will be paid on May 30.
